title: platform-standup-2026-03-19
content:
Attendees: Samira, Liam, Priya, Miguel, Eva (notes)

Highlights / high-level:
- Control plane canary rollout of routing service continued today; canary traffic at ~10% for region-us-west-2. Metrics look good (p99 latency steady). We did observe a small memory bump on one pod, will follow up.
- Routing policy change to prefer low-cost instances (PLAT-342) partially rolled out; need additional metrics to validate cost vs latency tradeoffs.
- Auth: short-lived token rotation work in progress. Priya validated KMS integration for token signing in staging.
- Quotas: rate limiter bug causing incorrect quota resets identified and patched in staging; hotfix candidate prepared (PR linked).

Control plane (Samira / Miguel)
- Canary notes: canary started 2026-03-18; today at 10% traffic. No error-rate increase. Observed sporadic OOM in pod rp-03 (node m-green-4) at ~02:30 UTC; likely due to recent cache sizing change.
  - Action: Miguel to repro with load test script and adjust cache limits. (Miguel, owner) -- target 2026-03-20.
  - Linked: PR to adjust cache sizing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1024
- Schema migration for route table (PLAT-358) is scheduled for 2026-03-22 window. Migration plan posted to Confluence.
  - Note: migrate in two phases to support rollback.
- Observability: Eva to add a p95/p99 memory alert for control-plane pods to catch similar regressions earlier.

Routing (Liam)
- Smart routing change (prefer-low-cost) deployed to canary. Early metrics: 6% improvement in avg-cost-per-token, 1.2% increase in p95 latency in eu-west-1.
  - Question: acceptable latency uplift? Product asked for cost threshold; need decision from Product-hosted-api.
  - Action: Liam to create a short A/B test dashboard comparing customer-critical paths; share with product by EOD 2026-03-20.
- Fallbacks: verified automatic fallback to baseline models when low-cost nodes saturate. Small race condition when multiple concurrent fallbacks happen; added locking patch to PR #1029.

Auth & Security (Priya)
- Short-lived token rotation proof-of-concept complete in staging. Integration with Cloud KMS for signing keys validated.
  - Next: run one-week soak test on staging tokens; verify session recovery flows for long-running streaming clients.
- SSO / SAML: working with Security to update cert rotation playbook. No immediate impact to customers.
- Incident note: transient 401 spike on 2026-03-18 14:10 UTC for a subset of internal services; root cause was a TTL mis-sync in token cache after deploy. Fixed by clearing cache during deploy.
  - Action: Priya to add cache-clear step to deploy checklist and add automated post-deploy validation that requests succeed.

Quotas & Rate Limiting (Eva)
- Found bug where per-customer quota counters were reset when upstream Redis reconnect occurred. Patch in staging (hotfix branch: fix/redis-quota-reset).
  - Hotfix candidate: roll to prod during low-traffic window 2026-03-20 01:00-03:00 UTC if perf tests pass.
  - Action: Eva to run extended load test and validate behavior under Redis failover.
- UI: quota usage telemetry now exported to metrics-sink; need to update Console to reflect more granular per-route quotas (product ticket opened).

Blockers / Risks
- Still open: decision on acceptable p95 latency increase for low-cost routing change. Product input required. (Liam)
- OOM observed in one canary pod; risk of wider rollout until cache limits confirmed. (Miguel)
- Hotfix window dependency on SRE availability for low-traffic deploy (coord with on-call). (Eva)

Action items (owners)
- Miguel: reproduce OOM with load tests and propose cache limit changes. Due: 2026-03-20.
- Liam: build A/B dashboard for routing cost vs latency and share with Product-hosted-api. Due: 2026-03-20 EOD.
- Priya: add cache-clear step to deploy checklist and post-deploy auth validation. Due: 2026-03-21.
- Eva: run Redis failover load tests and validate hotfix; schedule prod window with SRE. Due: 2026-03-19 (start) / finalize by 2026-03-20.
- Samira: finalize canary rollback criteria doc and publish to Confluence. Due: 2026-03-19.

Notes / follow-ups
- Add a short post-mortem template link to Confluence for the 401 spike: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PLAT/401-spike-2026-03-18
- Consider a temporary throttle for non-critical bulk jobs if low-cost routing increases p95 in production.
- Slack threads:
  - #platform-prod: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C01234567/p1700212345000100
  - #platform-routing: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C02345678/p1700219002000200

Misc
- Standup attendance rotating: next week Liam will run daily standup for coverage.
- Housekeeping: please update Jira tickets when you pick up action items to keep status current.

End of notes.
